reviewText:
We had an amazing experience at Yala Safari! 🐆🌿

The whole environment was absolutely beautiful peaceful surroundings, lovely weather and incredible views throughout the safari. We saw so many animals, especially lots of deer, and the biggest highlight was getting to see a leopard! ❤️

Our driver was very friendly and professional. We really appreciated the effort he made to find and show us as many animals as possible. His good attitude and hospitality made the experience even better.

We were also impressed by how clean and well-maintained the toilets inside the yala were, which was a pleasant surprise.

The restaurant near the sea inside Yala was another highlight. It was such a beautiful, quiet, and relaxing place to take a break during the safari and enjoy the surroundings.

Overall, we absolutely loved the environment, wildlife, hospitality, and the entire experience. A truly memorable day at Yala! 🦌🐘🐆🌿 Highly recommended!

Absolutely a must-go experience! Unfortunately, block 1 & block 2 were closed during our visit due to lack of rain this year, and the closed area has the most leopards. We only went block 5, although we couldn't see leopards, there were still many other animals to see - elephants, deers, monkeys, crocodile, etc
